title: tdh.synth.LFOscil.ui~
description: `tdh.synth.LFOscil.ui~` is a GUI-controlled oscillator for generating waveforms at very low frequencies, down to 0.127 Hz through its controls, for uses such as vibrato and tremolo. It accepts signal inputs for frequency and amplitude modulation, provides depth controls for each, and can be configured through either its GUI or external messages; its frequency can be set in Hz, MIDI pitch, or pitch class.
